registries.reason: Legacy arbitrary Tailwind values are migration debt.
registries.removalCondition: Retire only when apps/web production source has zero arbitrary values or an equivalent zero-tolerance rule owns the same scope.

registries.reason: The legacy --linear-* token namespace is migration debt.
registries.removalCondition: Retire only when the legacy namespace reaches zero and canonical semantic tokens own every consumer.

registries.reason: Duplicate drift-prone component families remain above canon.
registries.removalCondition: Retire only after each family is represented by its approved canonical component set and a zero-tolerance ownership rule replaces the ratchet.

registries.reason: Bespoke EmptyState paths are explicit migration exceptions.
registries.removalCondition: Retire when every product empty state composes the canonical EmptyState primitive or has an approved permanent owner contract.

registries.reason: Legacy system-b button surface classes are retired migration debt.
registries.removalCondition: Retire when an equivalent zero-tolerance rule permanently prevents legacy button surface classes.

registries.reason: Named legacy button surface exceptions are explicit migration debt.
registries.removalCondition: Retire when the exception set is empty and a zero-tolerance source rule owns the same surface.

registries.reason: Raw button elements bypass canonical Button behavior and states.
registries.removalCondition: Retire when raw production buttons reach zero or an AST rule proves every remaining raw element has an explicit canonical exception.

registries.reason: Shared presentation layers must remain portable and client-safe.
registries.removalCondition: Retire only when the zero baseline is replaced by an equivalent import-boundary rule over atoms, molecules, and organisms.

registries.reason: Hand-rolled sidebar rows drift from compact-navigation canon.
registries.removalCondition: Retire only when the zero baseline is replaced by a structural rule that requires SidebarNavItem ownership.

registries.reason: Sidebar paths excluded from the compact-navigation detector are explicit exceptions.
registries.removalCondition: Retire when the allowlist is empty and every sidebar row is evaluated by the canonical detector.

registries.reason: Direct destructive dialog paths bypass the canonical confirmation molecule.
registries.removalCondition: Retire when every destructive flow uses the canonical confirmation molecule and the exception set is empty.

registries.reason: Raw color classes can bypass semantic contrast ownership.
registries.removalCondition: Retire only when all tracked raw-color categories remain zero under an equivalent zero-tolerance source rule.

registries.reason: Sub-44px interactive hit targets are accessibility debt.
registries.removalCondition: Retire when the baseline reaches zero and the touch-target detector remains a zero-tolerance gate.

registries.reason: Shared UI arbitrary visual values bypass canonical tokens.
registries.removalCondition: Retire when packages/ui contains zero tracked arbitrary visual values and the detector remains zero-tolerance.

registries.reason: Serif usage is an explicit exception to Jovie type authority.
registries.removalCondition: Retire when design governance encodes the same zero-exception type-authority rule without an exception registry.

registries.reason: Uncovered canonical component surfaces are certification debt.
registries.removalCondition: Retire only when full story coverage is enforced by an equivalent zero-tolerance certification rule.

registries.reason: Legacy component IDs are not yet bound to canonical evidence.
registries.removalCondition: Retire when every catalog component is evidence-bound and the manifest schema no longer permits legacy unbound IDs.
